paragraphs: Serie A pages summarise how often matches go Over 2.5, how frequently both teams score, and how results split between home wins, draws and away wins. Italian seasons can start cautiously before opening up; the table leader and market rates on this page update as more rounds finish.
When a side is on a short unbeaten run but the BTTS rate is flat, drill into fixtures from the homepage. The league view explains the division; the match view explains the next kick-off.
